summary.text: Embroidered Tower is a rank eight Immortal Gu House of Heavenly Court, a red jade pavilion whose embroidery needles pierce Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's ghostly hand.

claims.text: At Yi Tian Mountain, when Ying Wu Xie keeps putting successive Heaven Overseeing Tower lords into dream realms, Heavenly Court Gu Immortals bring out a second Immortal Gu House, Embroidered Tower. It looks exquisite and already shows broken foundational support from earlier damage, so it is fielded as a damaged object rather than an intact house. Bo Qing hits it with five finger fist heart sword; the tower shakes, then shoots seven embroidery needles of faint light that pierce Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s ghostly hand and the ground until the hand cannot rise. Inside the tower, a Heavenly Court immortal states that Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable prepared Embroidered Tower as dowry for his disciple Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, and that when Reckless Savage Demon Venerable rampaged into Heavenly Court and was struck by this move, he had to discard three bloody skins to free himself. The sewing uses dao marks as threads, so raising the hand would mean lifting Southern Border’s ground; the remaining soul cannot, then the hand turns soft, floods out as soul water, and a giant form smashes Embroidered Tower at once.

Later observers note that immobilizing one ghostly hand was only one of Spectral Soul’s thousand, and that a lower portion of a leg stays sewn to the ground from that earlier Embroidered Tower attack.

Inside Heavenly Court, Feng Jiu Ge is stationed in Embroidered Tower. Three bloody skins hang sewn in the air above it with traces of primal savagery; Reckless Savage Demon Venerable left them when the tower stopped him, after destroying half the house in a way Heavenly Court could not repair. Feng Jiu Ge comes there to comprehend a trace of transformation from those skins, and from that work he aims toward Destiny Song.

Embroidered Tower began as a mortal object Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable left to Star Constellation as dowry; its symbolic meaning was greater than its power under the customs of that time. After she became Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, she turned it into an Immortal Gu House with mystical powers. Over a million years earlier, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s path through Heavenly Court passed Embroidered Tower before Central Great Hall and Heaven Overseeing Tower. The tower’s trump card, Dao Embroidery, sent seven embroidery needles; he discarded three pieces of skin, and those skins were sewn into the air by dao mark threads. The damage could not be repaired, and later use against Spectral Soul at Yi Tian Mountain added new damage until the tower could not be used.

Halfway through Heavenly Court, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable stops before Embroidered Tower. Star Constellation’s will enters the house and names it one of the methods her main body left behind. After a short clash he finds the tower near collapse, says he will not destroy it, and leaves the three bloody skins as his inheritance for whoever can take them, warning that the skins are already tied to Heavenly Court dao marks.

Feng Jiu Ge tells Fang Yuan that in Heavenly Court’s Embroidered Tower there are three true inheritances left by Reckless Savage Demon Venerable, each needing a key: attitude Gu, mutation Gu, and adaptation Gu.
In the fate war, Fang Yuan purposely takes a hit from Duke Long, falls toward Embroidered Tower, and activates Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s hidden arrangement.

After the fate war, Fang Yuan holds Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s method. After Star Constellation Immortal Venerable revives, she quickly modifies Embroidered Tower until it is complete again and more profound and powerful. She uses the tower and dao embroidery personally to weave wisdom path and star path dao marks across the surrounding ten thousand li.
